mechanics.point_of_view: Third-person objective narration with almost no interior access; the reader watches and listens.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Parataxis; dialogue over stated feeling; ellipsis of the decisive subject; iceberg omission.
mechanics.emotional_progression: The conflict is never named; tension accumulates through misaligned speech and small gestures, leaving the reader to infer what is at stake.
mechanics.dialogue: Sparse, indirect exchanges where the real subject is avoided; register stays light while the situation is serious.
mechanics.verification_note: Standard iceberg exemplar; story publication and collection confirmed.
